content:
Sam: Heads up  dropped a second pass on the routing policies editor. Need quick feedback on keyboard flow + validation copy before dev starts Monday.
Tess: Seen. Quick skim: love the compact rule cards. Two things: 1) reordering affordance on mobile, 2) clearer validation states.
Anika: Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abc  I changed the reorder handle to a taller 32px target and added a drag hint.
Maya: Reordering note: when you move a rule, do we re-evaluate priorities client-side or send a reorder event to server? UX needs immediate feedback.
Jon: We should optimistic-update in UI then call PATCH /policies/:id/order. If server validation fails (conflict) revert + show toast.
Sam: Good. Validation types we discussed: ERROR = structural (duplicate condition + same priority), WARNING = shadowed rule, INFO = performance tip (large regex). Proposed short messages:
- ERROR: "Conflicting rule 11 change priority or conditions."
- WARNING: "This rule is shadowed by higher-priority rules."
- INFO: "Complex condition may increase routing latency."
Tess: The ERROR copy is a bit terse. Suggest: "Conflicting rule detected. Adjust priority or conditions to resolve."
Anika: Updated copy in Figma. Also added inline help: a ? tooltip that explains the priority model: "Higher priority rules run first; equal priority uses created-at."
Maya: Accessibility: need to announce diagnostics changes. Add an aria-live region and set role="status" so screen readers pick up new errors immediately.
Kai: We'll implement aria-live="polite" for non-blocking messages and aria-live="assertive" for ERROR-level diagnostics. Also will ensure the drag handle has aria-grabbed and keyboard up/down reordering.
Sam: Nice. For the preview simulator, team wants to see which condition matched. UX proposal: small trace under the preview like: Request -> Rule #42 (user-agent contains "curl") -> Fallback -> Model B.
Jon: Backend will return a trace like: 
```
[{"rule_id":"42","matched_condition":"ua:curl"},{"action":"route","target":"model-b"},{"fallback":"model-c"}]
```
We can render that into the trace panel.
Tess: If trace contains circular fallbacks, show ERROR and highlight involved rules. Example copy: "Circular fallback between rule 3 and rule 7."
Maya: UX for blocking saves: show an inline red banner at top of editor + disable Save button. For warnings show a subtle yellow bar and a small "Save anyway" secondary action.
Sam: Question: should "Save anyway" exist for warnings? I worry about accidental saves that degrade routes.
Anika: We already have similar in Deploy flows. Use a confirmation modal: "This policy has warnings. Save anyway?" with link to "View warnings".
Kai: Addendum: keyboard users must be able to dismiss modal with Esc and the modal should trap focus.
Tess: Visual contrast: priority badge color fails 3:1 in some themes. I ran a check and the small white text on orange is 2.6:1. Recommend swap to dark text on pale background for badges.
Sam: Make a note: badges should be >= 3:1. Psalm can run final a11y pass (added as comment).
Maya: Empty state for rules list: current placeholder says "No rules yet"  change to action-driven copy: "No routing rules. Click \"Add routing rule\" to get started."
Anika: Agreed. Also renamed input placeholder from "Add rule..." to "Add routing rule" to reduce ambiguity.
Jon: For tests, I'll include deterministic preview seeds so designers can reproduce same trace. Add query param ?seed=1234 that the simulator honors.
Sam: Sounds good. Small microcopy: tooltip on reorder handle: "Reorder rule (higher priority at top)".
Tess: Motion: for reduced-motion users, disable pulsing highlight and use a thin border flash instead.
Kai: We'll respect prefers-reduced-motion and set reduced animations in CSS variables.
design-bot: @channel New comment on Figma by Anika: "Updated error copy and trace layout"
Sam: Thanks folks. Action list: Anika update Figma copy + tooltip, Kai implement aria-live + keyboard reorder stub, Jon add seed support in simulator, Tess to confirm contrast numbers, Maya prototype instant scroll + focus behavior. Back at 10:30 if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
Tess: I'll post contrast screenshots in the thread after running the check.
Maya: One last tiny thing: when preview highlights a rule, call element.focus() so screen readers announce it; don't auto-open the edit panel.
Sam: Yep. Ok thumbs up. We'll freeze copy by EOD and hand to eng Monday morning.
